title: Define catalogue and file schemas
acceptance_criteria: Stable source and file IDs plus observation and coverage fields documented; seed queue imported without treating links as downloads

title: Reconcile districts blocks and boundary sources
acceptance_criteria: 24 Jharkhand and 30 Odisha report-listed districts reconciled to dated boundary codes; aliases and partial report coverage recorded; geometry rights checked

title: Define acquisition and sharing rules
acceptance_criteria: Raw preservation and filter recording rules agreed; rights and sensitivity statuses defined; no upload without approval

title: Acquire pilot official chemistry exports
acceptance_criteria: Try each state export and metadata; validate file type and record filters dates rights checksum; document blockers and manual handoff without claiming acquisition

title: Acquire pilot NAQUIM and brochure PDFs
acceptance_criteria: Obtain 2-3 contextual PDFs prioritizing Koderma and Balasore; validate readable files and record actual blocks maps and annexes; log access failures

title: Verify and obtain pilot literature
acceptance_criteria: Inspect latest Sukinda article and one paired pilot paper when obtainable; verify DOI sampling dates supplements coordinates original-data origin and reuse conditions

title: Extract and normalize pilot records
acceptance_criteria: Traceable station sample result and water-level CSVs for acquired evidence; raw IDs values units qualifiers and page-table references preserved; no invented coordinates

title: Run pilot quality and overlap checks
acceptance_criteria: Coordinate date unit null and duplicate checks with explicit flags; source overlaps and depth uncertainty reviewed; source well sample and result counts distinguished

title: Build verified coverage inventory
acceptance_criteria: Source-to-area rows and permitted geometry distinguish district context named blocks study footprint and station locations; unknown coverage remains explicit

title: Confirm sharing mode and map platform
acceptance_criteria: Recipient tests pilot platform; public versus restricted and online versus offline decisions recorded; hosting upload approved before transfer

title: Build first linked coverage map
acceptance_criteria: Searchable catalogue plus boundaries and evidence-stream points; popups link permitted reports and CSVs; filters counts caveats and recipient access verified

title: Expand CGWB publication and data archive
acceptance_criteria: Inventory all report-listed districts and modern repository matches; reconcile 27 Odisha legacy links against 30 districts; validate downloads and retain an explicit gap list

title: Add complementary evidence streams
acceptance_criteria: Stage JJM state geology NGDR water-level and literature acquisitions separately; metadata rights and overlap assessed before map ingestion

title: Submit targeted subsurface data requests
acceptance_criteria: Pilot missing fields documented and requests sent through approved official routes; district period format metadata and reuse terms specified; response log maintained

title: Prioritize remaining geographic and temporal gaps
acceptance_criteria: Gap matrix by district block year season parameter evidence stream and depth; next batch ranked without inferring risk from search visibility

title: Package and test first recipient release
acceptance_criteria: Guide CSVs permitted PDFs map dictionary limitations and checksum manifest packaged; rights-reviewed hosted or offline links and recipient exploration test pass

title: Version and maintain later releases
acceptance_criteria: Repeatable update process with version dates checksums change log broken links and manual-request queue; later batches do not overwrite raw originals
